summary: First-finish smoke test of HydrantRoute SP. All 10 backend endpoints work correctly (including Nominatim geocoding and OSRM route optimization). Frontend loads, seeds 6 hydrants with map pins, generates optimized route with valid Google Maps URL, manual form adds hydrants, clear-all works. GPS permission denied as expected, app correctly falls back to São Paulo center (-23.5612,-46.6558).
passed: POST /api/hydrants/seed creates 6 hydrants, all geocoded=true with valid SP lat/lon
POST /api/hydrants creates manual hydrant, geocoded=true (Faria Lima 500)
PUT /api/hydrants/{id} updates street & regeocodes (Haddock Lobo, new lat -23.5564378)
POST /api/hydrants/bulk CSV upload imports 2 rows, both geocoded
POST /api/route/optimize returns total_distance_km=16.21, total_duration_min=31.1, stops ordered 1..6, google_maps_url contains origin+destination+waypoints
Frontend header 'HYDRANTROUTE SP' renders with GPS fallback banner 'permissão negada - usando centro de SP'
Stats bar shows Total=6, Operacional=4, Inoperante=2, Geocodificados=6
data-testid=seed-btn populates map with 6 pins and table rows

data-testid=generate-route-btn opens dialog showing ordered stops 1-6, distance, time, and data-testid=google-maps-link with valid https://www.google.com/maps URL (origin/destination/waypoints all present)
Manual form (input-code/input-street/input-number + submit-hydrant-btn) creates TEST_UI-1 which appears in the list
notes: CSV tab's upload-csv-btn/download-template-btn were not visible because the Manual tab was active during the smoke test; CSV functionality itself verified via /api/hydrants/bulk endpoint. Two accessibility console warnings about Missing Description/aria-describedby on DialogContent (non-blocking).
